annotation.title_clean: Communiqué of the Regional Conference on the Peace and Security Aspects of Autonomous Weapons Systems: An ECOWAS Perspective
annotation.title_en: Communiqué of the Regional Conference on the Peace and Security Aspects of Autonomous Weapons Systems: An ECOWAS Perspective
annotation.authors_or_issuer: ECOWAS Member States representatives (Regional Conference, Freetown, Sierra Leone)
annotation.summary_en: Communiqué by ECOWAS Member States from a April 2024 Freetown conference on autonomous weapons systems. It voices ethical, humanitarian and proliferation concerns, and commits states to support urgent negotiation of a legally binding instrument with prohibitions and regulations, ensure meaningful human control, and develop a common regional position.
key_provisions_or_claims: Supports urgent negotiation of a legally binding instrument with prohibitions and regulations on autonomous weapons
Stresses meaningful human control and human dignity
Warns of proliferation to non-state armed groups and arms race risks
Commits to regional cooperation toward a common ECOWAS position
Cites UNGA 2023 resolution, Belén Communiqué, CARICOM Declaration, ACHPR Resolution 473
